info.title: HippoBridge FHIR API
info.description: FHIR-compatible API for accessing patient data from the Hipocrate medical system

get.description: Returns the web interface for patient analysis with CNP input form
Returns the FHIR capability statement for this server
Returns this OpenAPI specification in JSON format

get.summary: Search report passages (one DocumentReference per document)
get.description: Ranked full-text search over the indexed epicrisis/imaging text. Unlike Patient?content= it returns one searchset entry per document, best first, each carrying its best passage(s). Words are prefix-matched with diacritics folded; "quoted" = phrase, a|b = alternatives for one word. Matching happens inside one passage (a sentence group of about 600 characters; never across a paragraph or section header): with match=all every word must be in the same passage, with min-match that many words in one passage. Only validated text by default. content[0].attachment.data is the best passage(s) as plain text (NOT base64), joined by a blank line (passages never contain one, so split on it). Extensions: one search-passage (valueString = section header in force, e.g. Concluzii, empty if none) per passage, same order; and search-identifiers (sub-extensions with valueString; url = name, family-name, given-name, cnp, birth-date, address, city, phone, email, insurance-number, fo-number, barcode, only those the HIS page held) for de-identification. Relatives and employer are not on the scraped pages, so not returned. id = Encounter id (kind epicrisis) or request id (kind imaging). Extensions search-score (valueDecimal; whole query words in the best passage + bm25 fraction, higher is better) and search-matched (valueInteger; query words found anywhere in the document). Same auth as Patient?content= (401 on bad credentials); OperationOutcome not-supported when no cache.dir is configured. Documents indexed before this endpoint existed have no date/modality/status until the startup cache rescan re-parses them; until then they are not returned.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Words, "quoted phrases", a|b alternatives

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: all = every word (default), any = at least min-match words

parameters.name: min-match
parameters.description: With match=any: minimum words present in the document

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Comma list: epicrisis, imaging

parameters.name: modality
parameters.description: Comma list of DICOM codes (MR, CT, US, CR, OT); imaging only

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: FHIR date with optional eq/ge/gt/le/lt prefix (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD); repeatable. Study date (imaging) or discharge date (epicrisis).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: final (default), draft or any. Draft = imaging result not yet validated.

parameters.name: _count
parameters.description: Most documents returned

parameters.name: max-chars
parameters.description: Total length of the passage(s) returned per document

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Neighbouring passages added each side of every best passage

200.description: searchset Bundle of DocumentReference (type.text = kind, category = modality, date, description = exam name), entry.search.score set

400.description: OperationOutcome: missing content or invalid parameter

get.description: Documents indexed per kind, modality and status, date range and time of the last write (epoch seconds). Plain JSON, not a FHIR resource.

200.description: {total, by_kind, by_modality, by_status, date_min, date_max, last_indexed}

get.description: Search for patients by name, CNP, patient code, or partial CNP (q), or by words in their indexed report text (content). Returns FHIR Patient resources or Bundle. One of q or content is required.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term (patient name, CNP, patient code, or partial CNP ending with *). Not required when content is given.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Full-text search over indexed epicrisis/imaging report text (same index and semantics as /api/search/text). Takes precedence over q; returns a searchset Bundle of Patient stubs (id = CNP, name) with extensions search-snippet (matches in <mark>), search-count, and one search-document per matching document: a nested extension with sub-extensions kind and id (valueString). kind is 'epicrisis' (id = Encounter id for /fhir/Encounter/{id}?type=checkout; indexed text = the epicrisis, i.e. note[0].text of that Encounter) or 'imaging' (id = request id for /fhir/ImagingStudy/{id}, not a DiagnosticReport id; indexed text = the study results, i.e. the category-less note[].text entries of that ImagingStudy). The justification and discharge-diagnosis notes are not indexed, and the snippet is a slice of the indexed text (may contain Markdown syntax) with <mark> around matches. Credentials are validated against Hipocrate. 401 on bad credentials; OperationOutcome not-supported when no cache.dir is configured.

parameters.name: snippet_length
parameters.description: With content: snippet size in tokens, clamped to 1-64, default 12

200.description: Single Patient or Bundle of Patients. With content: a searchset Bundle, one Patient stub per matching patient (max 25), entry.search.mode = match

400.description: Missing search term (neither q nor content), or non-integer snippet_length

get.description: Retrieve an imaging study by ID as FHIR ImagingStudy resource. Report text is in note[].text (Annotation): an optional first note with category[0].text = 'clinical-indication' (the request justification), then one note per study result (the radiology report, no category). series[].description is the study title, reason[0].text the clinical diagnosis. There is no DiagnosticReport or narrative (text.div) element.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Study ID

200.description: Imaging study as FHIR ImagingStudy resource

get.description: Retrieve encounter/checkout information by ID as FHIR Encounter resource. There is no narrative (text.div) element.

get.summary: Full-text search over indexed report text
get.description: Free-text search (SQLite FTS5, diacritic-insensitive, each word is a prefix match, all words must match) over epicrisis and imaging-report text already indexed by this server. Scoped to documents that have passed through the bridge (live traffic plus backfill), not a Hipocrate-wide search. Results are grouped one per patient (best-ranked document's snippet, per-kind counts, ids of all matching documents), capped at 25 patients. Credentials are validated against Hipocrate (whoami) before searching. {"enabled": false} when no cache.dir is configured.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (Romanian diacritics optional)

parameters.name: snippet_length
parameters.description: Snippet size in tokens (words); clamped to 1-64 (FTS5 limit), default 12

200.description: {"enabled": true, "results": [...]}, or {"enabled": false} when the index is disabled. Each result: kind (epicrisis|imaging), source_id, patient_cnp, patient_name, updated_at (epoch seconds), snippet (matches wrapped in <mark>), count, kinds ({kind: n}), documents ([{kind, source_id}] — source_id is the checkout id for epicrisis, the request id for imaging; fetch via /api/checkout/{id} or /api/study/{id})

get.description: Returns entry count, total size, age range, and a by_table breakdown (entries per endpoint kind, e.g. cache_patient/cache_checkout/...) of the on-disk SQLite HTTP cache. {"enabled": false} when no cache.dir is configured.

post.description: Deletes expired/oversized entries from the on-disk SQLite HTTP cache and returns counts. No-op ({"enabled": false}) when no cache.dir is configured.

Generate a free-text AI summary for one item, in-process against the configured LLM provider (llm.cfg). Results are cached (in-memory + disk) keyed by (kind, sha256(text)). These are deliberately weak-guarantee aids: no schema, no validation.

check_only.description: Skip generation, just report whether a cached summary exists

400.description: Invalid JSON, unknown kind, empty text, or not enough clinical content to summarize

503.description: AI summaries not configured, or the AI service is unreachable

post.description: Streaming counterpart to /api/ai/summarize, for kind in {report, epicrisis, pre_exam, lab}. On a cache hit the full cached text is written as a single chunk. Mid-stream failures can't change the HTTP status (client already committed to 200) — signalled instead with a sentinel: ASCII Unit Separator + "ERROR" + Unit Separator + message.

200.description: text/plain streamed summary chunks (or a mid-stream error sentinel)

400.description: Invalid JSON, unsupported kind, empty text, or not enough clinical content to summarize
